description: This file is a JUnit test class for the VisitService in the openmrs-core project. It contains various test cases to verify the behavior of visit management, including CRUD operations, validation, and related entity handling in the OpenMRS API.

classes.name: VisitServiceTest
classes.description: This test class extends BaseContextSensitiveTest and includes extensive test cases for the VisitService component, validating core functionalities such as CRUD operations, validation, voiding/unvoiding, and related entity handling.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing the VisitService instance and configuring global properties.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes_shouldGetAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Verifies that getAllVisitTypes() retrieves all visit types.

methods.name: getVisitType_shouldGetCorrectVisitType
methods.description: Tests that getVisitType() returns the correct VisitType object for a valid ID.

methods.name: getVisitType_shouldReturnNullIfVisitTypeIsNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that getVisitType() returns null for a non-existent ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid_shouldGetCorrentVisitType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of VisitType by UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfVisitTypeIsNotFound
methods.description: Verifies null return when UUID does not correspond to any VisitType.

methods.name: getVisitTypes_shouldGetCorrentVisitTypes
methods.description: Checks retrieval of VisitTypes filtered by name patterns.

methods.name: getVisitTypes_shouldReturnAnEmptyListIfNoVisitTypesAreFound
methods.description: Ensures an empty list is returned if no matching VisitTypes are found.

methods.name: saveVisitType_shouldSaveNewVisitType
methods.description: Verifies creating and saving a new VisitType.

methods.name: saveVisitType_shouldSaveEditedVisitType
methods.description: Tests editing and saving an existing VisitType.

methods.name: retireVisitType_shouldRetireGivenVisitType
methods.description: Checks that a VisitType can be retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretireVisitType_shouldUnretireGivenVisitType
methods.description: Verifies that a retired VisitType can be unretired.

methods.name: purgeVisitType_shouldDeleteGivenVisitType
methods.description: Confirms that a VisitType can be permanently deleted.

methods.name: getAllVisits_shouldReturnAllUnvoidedVisits
methods.description: Checks that getAllVisits() returns all non-voided visits.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid_shouldReturnAVisitMatchingTheSpecifiedUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Visit by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldAddANewVisitToTheDatabase
methods.description: Verifies that a new Visit can be saved and is assigned an ID and UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldSaveAVisitThoughChangedByAndDateCreatedAreNotSetForVisitAttributeExplictly
methods.description: Tests saving a visit with explicit VisitAttribute without setting creator and date.

methods.name: createVisitAttributeWithoutCreatorAndDateCreated
methods.description: Helper method to create a VisitAttribute without creator and date fields.

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldVoidAnAttributeIfMaxOccursIs1AndSameAttributeTypeAlreadyExists
methods.description: Ensures that adding a second attribute of maxOccurs=1 voids the previous one.

methods.name: createVisitAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to create a VisitAttribute with a specific value.

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldUpdateAnExistingVisitInTheDatabase
methods.description: Checks that modifications to a visit (like location) are persisted.

methods.name: voidVisit_shouldVoidTheVisitAndSetTheVoidReason
methods.description: Verifies voiding a Visit updates void fields and user info.

methods.name: voidVisit_shouldVoidEncountersWithVisit
methods.description: Ensures encounters linked to a visit are voided when the visit is voided.

methods.name: unvoidVisit_shouldUnvoidTheVisitAndUnsetAllTheVoidRelatedFields
methods.description: Checks that a voided visit can be unvoided, resetting void fields.

methods.name: unvoidVisit_shouldUnvoidEncountersVoidedWithVisit
methods.description: Verifies that encounters voided with a visit are unvoided accordingly.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient_shouldReturnEmptyListGivenNull
methods.description: Test that null patient returns empty list.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient_shouldReturnEmptyListGivenPatientWithNullPatientId
methods.description: Same as above, for patient with null ID.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient_shouldReturnAllUnvoidedVisitsForTheSpecifiedPatient
methods.description: Checks retrieval of patient's active visits.

methods.name: getActiveVisitsByPatient_shouldReturnAllUnvoidedActiveVisitsForTheSpecifiedPatient
methods.description: Fetches active (non-voided) visits for patient with associated data set.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient_shouldReturnEmptyListGivenNullAndFalse
methods.description: Ensures null patient produces empty list.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetVisitsByIndications
methods.description: Tests filtering visits by specific indication concepts.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetVisitsByLocations
methods.description: Tests filtering visits by given locations.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetVisitsByVisitType
methods.description: Checks filtering visits by visit types.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetVisitsEndedBetweenTheGivenEndDates
methods.description: Verifies filtering of visits by end date range.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetVisitsThatAreStillOpenEvenIfMinStartDatetimeIsSpecified
methods.description: Ensures open visits are retrieved even if min start date is specified.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetVisitsStartedBetweenTheGivenStartDates
methods.description: Tests start date filtering.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldReturnAllVisitsIfIncludeVoidedIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Validates retrieval of all visits including voided.

methods.name: saveVisitType_shouldThrowErrorWhenNameIsNull
methods.description: Test for validation: null name should throw APIException.

methods.name: saveVisitType_shouldThrowErrorWhenNameIsEmptyString

methods.name: getAllVisitAttributeTypes_shouldReturnAllVisitAttributeTypesIncludingRetiredOnes

methods.name: purgeVisitAttributeType_shouldCompletelyRemoveAVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Permanent deletion of an attribute type.

methods.name: retireVisitAttributeType_shouldRetireAVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Marks attribute type as retired with a reason.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType_shouldCreateANewVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Creates and saves a new VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType_shouldEditAnExistingVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Updates an existing VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: unretireVisitAttributeType_shouldUnretireARetiredVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Reverts retirement status of an attribute type.

methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoVisitAttributeHasTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Null response for missing UUID.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldGetAllVisitsWithGivenAttributeValues
methods.description: Filters visits based on attribute values.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldNotFindAnyVisitsIfNoneHaveGivenAttributeValues
methods.description: Returns empty list when no matches.

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldFailIfValidationErrorsAreFound

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldPassIfNoValidationErrorsAreFound

methods.name: saveVisit_shouldBeAbleToAddAnAttributeToAVisit
